concerns.location: tasks.md:Dependencies and requirement coverage — 'T066–T069 are independent of each other ([P] where files differ)'
concerns.text: T067 is not actually parallel-safe with T066. T067 requires the final report to include a 'resource usage' section and its verification runs the pipeline in --ci-mode, which per T066 runs 'under the monitor' and appends per-stage entries to artifacts/reports/performance_benchmark.json. If T067 executes before T066 lands, the benchmark JSON has no monitor entries and the resource-usage section cannot be populated/verified. Either order T067 after T066 or drop the [P] claim for that pair.
